method: PubMed ELink Similar Articles through the PubMed plugin
role: Gap detection only. Returned titles were not cited unless they independently entered the verified extraction set and their abstract was inspected.

seeds.topic: Cannabis risks and benefits umbrella review
seeds.disposition: No new source added. The seed umbrella review already synthesized the relevant psychiatric meta-analyses; unrelated treatment/pain results were not advanced.

seeds.topic: Childhood ADHD to adult functional outcomes
seeds.disposition: No new primary source added solely from the related-article list. The late-onset/persistence uncertainty was separately covered by an inspected critical review (PMID 30843223), and PMID 40287009 was already in the screened evidence set.
